mission: Mission 3CZ - PopSign fresh5 revised scratch architecture/input contract packet

head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 contract handoff

scope.purpose: Bind the M3CY-selected scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract route into concrete architecture/input ids, tensor and motion-channel semantics, budget gates, diagnostics, future metric gates, and stop/downscope conditions before any implementation or fitting can be considered.

source_supported_observations.observation: M3CY selected scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract and exactly one next action, draft_revised_scratch_architecture_input_contract_packet_no_training, while keeping implementation, fitting, Brev, export, promotion, final-gate changes, source/data/tensor mutation, product recognition claims, and push unauthorized.
M3CX selected revise_scratch_architecture_input_design_no_training instead of product downscope or stop, because observer 435 did not select STOP and authorized design-only review.

Observer 435 authorized local no-training/no-implementation strategy and design work only; it did not authorize fitting, Brev, export, browser activation, source expansion, pseudo-labeling, tensor mutation, architecture/input implementation, product recognition claims, or final-gate weakening.

M3CW classified the strongest current explanation as current_scratch_architecture_optimization_generalization_failure_under_existing_input_and_data_envelope and required current strategy reassessment before more training-style work.

M3CR ran the post-contract 20-epoch LR 0.003 bounded local train-all and validation accuracy stayed flat at 0.2; test top-1 was 0.2, macro F1 was 0.06666666666666668, and validation/test predictions collapsed to morning:125.
M3CT found train, validation, and test logits all collapsed to morning:125 top-1 and thank_you:125 top-2 with stable class ordering morning > thank_you > who > pen > home.
M3CU found train linear_input_post_layernorm features nonseparable with variance mean 2.7852715663804345e-8, between/within centroid ratio 0.3116968095914498, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.224.

M3CV localized collapse before LayerNorm/readout: train head_input_fused_pre_layernorm variance mean 0.00017123778903535984, between/within centroid ratio 0.3368962860376266, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.176.

M3CK-M3CQ reduce total loader, label-index, gradient, architecture-connectivity, label-count imbalance, split leakage, tensor corruption, sampler/evaluator, optimizer/loss, checkpoint-selection, and threshold-only explanations.

The approved PopSign fresh5 tensors are rgb_regions with shape 16x5x96x96x3, dtype torch.uint8, and region order viewer_left_hand_context, viewer_right_hand_context, upper_body_signing_space, head_context, full_frame_reference.

The existing region-axis-preserving loader consumes rgb_regions as T,R,H,W,C and prepares B,T,R,C,H,W for region-grid training/evaluation; the failed scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 classifier requires 6D B,T,R,C,H,W.

The failed classifier encodes each frame-region through a shared scratch 2D encoder, runs per-region temporal blocks, mean-pools temporal features with temporal.mean(dim=2), applies region attention after temporal pooling, then uses LayerNorm and a linear head.
web/public/model/model-card.json remains status not_trained; docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json remains modelVersion rawframe-not-trained with activeLabels [] and evidenceArtifacts [].

reviewer_inference: The failed architecture/input envelope likely compressed discriminative sequence and cross-region evidence too early for the current PopSign fresh5 data envelope; the observed collapse is already present in train representations, not only in held-out evaluation or thresholding.

The next recognizer-lane action can be a no-training scaffold prompt only if it implements this contract in a separate bounded milestone and proves shapes, parameter count, no-pretrained dependencies, and browser budget before any fitting.

The derived motion-channel contract is still a design contract; it is not evidence that a future model will learn, and it does not authorize tensor regeneration, architecture code changes, fitting, or paid compute in this mission.

Product downscope/no-recognition remains the honest fallback if the scaffold cannot preserve the shape, source, privacy, no-pretrained, and browser budget constraints without a human scope or final-claim decision.

selected_contract.summary: A future from-scratch browser-bounded architecture contract that consumes approved PopSign fresh5 rgb_regions, derives per-region adjacent-frame motion evidence on the fly without tensor mutation, keeps time x region tokens through interaction layers, models cross-region relationships before global pooling, and exposes representation diagnostics before any future train-all.

prepared_existing_input_contract.normalization: Convert uint8 rgb_regions to float tensor in the future model/input path only; no stored tensor mutation.

channel_groups.name: signed_adjacent_delta_rgb
channel_groups.definition: current normalized RGB minus previous normalized RGB for the same region; t=0 is zeros

channel_groups.name: absolute_adjacent_delta_rgb
channel_groups.definition: absolute value of signed_adjacent_delta_rgb; t=0 is zeros

derived_motion_contract.permitted_future_implementation_location: Inside a future model/input adapter or dataloader transform under a separate authorized scaffold prompt; not materialized into manifests or tensor files by M3CZ.

token_semantics: Each token represents one time index and one region id from the approved five-region PopSign fresh5 tensor.
Appearance and derived motion evidence must stay associated with the same time-region token until after at least one temporal interaction block and one cross-region interaction block.
Token metadata must retain time index and region id for future diagnostics.
cross_region_interaction_requirements: Cross-region interaction must occur before final temporal/global pooling.
The future scaffold must allow left hand, right hand, upper body signing space, head context, and full-frame reference tokens to exchange information at matching or nearby time indices.
The future scaffold must not rely solely on scalar region attention after each region has already been temporally pooled.
temporal_aggregation_requirements: No temporal mean pooling may be the primary class-evidence reducer before interaction layers.
Temporal aggregation must happen only after token-level motion and cross-region interaction have produced class-evidence features.
Final aggregation may use a learned class token, attention pooling, or late pooled token summary, but it must expose pre-pool token features for diagnostics.
normalization_requirements: Use per-clip or per-batch normalization compatible with browser inference and existing uint8 inputs.
Preserve enough pre-normalization and pre-head diagnostic tensors to distinguish collapse before normalization from collapse introduced by normalization/readout.
forbidden_architecture_patterns_for_this: pretrained detector, landmark, backbone, embedding, feature extractor, or pseudo-label dependency
early temporal mean pooling before time-region interaction
late-only region attention after per-region temporal pooling as the sole cross-region mechanism
architecture path that requires raw learner video upload during normal practice
architecture path that requires source, tensor, or manifest mutation before a separate approved prompt

assumptions_for_future_scaffold_prompt.target_runtime: browser-first inference with no raw learner video upload
assumptions_for_future_scaffold_prompt.target_export_path: future ONNX/browser export only after a trained artifact passes gates; export is not authorized here

required_before_implementation: Parameter count estimate and then measured parameter count must be recorded before any fitting.
Future scaffold must run a no-grad shape smoke with B=1 and B=2 over B,16,5,9,96,96 and return logits shaped B,5.
Future scaffold must record intermediate token shapes before temporal aggregation, after cross-region interaction, before final pooling, and before classifier head.
Future scaffold must prove no pretrained imports or loaded weights are introduced.
Future scaffold must keep parameter count at or below 3000000 unless a later human scope decision explicitly changes the budget.

Future scaffold must keep estimated single-example model input plus retained inference activations under a browser-oriented 64 MiB diagnostic budget for the first shape smoke, or stop for human scope decision.
Future scaffold must not alter model-card, active vocabulary, final gates, manifests, tensors, or source approvals.
required_before_brev_or_paid_compute: A separate compute receipt must record current human approval, brev ls --json state, duplicate-worker check, exact command, max runtime, max spend, kill condition, expected metric signal, artifact copyback, teardown, and default-off cleanup.
No Brev command, sync, lifecycle change, or remote execution is authorized by this M3CZ contract.

approved_source_contract.allowed_current_source_envelope: Existing approved PopSign fresh5 repaired manifests and tensors only.

before_future_fitting: No-grad scaffold diagnostic must emit feature tensors for token_embedding_pre_interaction, token_embedding_post_cross_region, token_embedding_post_temporal, pre_pool_tokens, pooled_pre_head, post_norm_head_input, and logits.
Diagnostic names and tensor axes must be stable enough that a future no-training or inference-only packet can compute variance and nearest-centroid statistics without modifying the training loop.
A future scaffold receipt must prove features are not constant for a synthetic or retained fixture input before any fitting command is allowed.
during_or_after_first_future_local_fitti: Train, validation, and test prediction distributions.
Per-label recall and zero-recall label list.
Logit/probability top-1 and top-2 class distributions.
Feature variance mean for pooled_pre_head and post_norm_head_input.
Between-label centroid distance, within-label distance, between/within ratio, and nearest-centroid accuracy for train-split pooled_pre_head and post_norm_head_input features.
Collapse localization statement separating token/interactions, pooling, normalization, and classifier head.

future_train_validation_test_metric_and_.allowed_future_fitting_envelope: Only under a later prompt that explicitly authorizes one bounded local fitting attempt after scaffold/shape/budget gates pass.
hard_stop_conditions_before_second_local: Validation top-1 remains at chance, macro F1 remains at 0.06666666666666668, and prediction distribution remains single-class after the first future local smoke.
Train split remains nonseparable by representation diagnostics at or below the M3CV between/within ratio and nearest-centroid accuracy neighborhood.
Any future implementation requires pretrained components, source expansion, tensor regeneration, manifest changes, raw learner upload, final-gate weakening, or model-card promotion to proceed.
A future scaffold cannot meet the parameter, memory, or shape-smoke gates without human scope approval.

force_product_downscope_reduced_claim_pl: The future no-training scaffold cannot meet the shape, parameter, browser-memory, no-pretrained, no-upload, and approved-source contracts.
A future local smoke under this route repeats chance-level validation/test collapse and train representation nonseparability without a new evidence-backed local diagnostic action.
The only plausible recognizer route would require source expansion, tensor regeneration, new labels, paid compute, or final-claim changes before local evidence improves.
force_stop_for_human_architecture_input_: The next meaningful action requires human approval for architecture complexity, code path, crop/region semantics, source rights, tensor mutation, budget, or product claim scope.
Browser budget gates conflict with the contract and the tradeoff cannot be resolved by a no-training local scaffold.
force_stop_scratch_recognizer_lane: No no-pretrained, no-upload, browser-viable scratch route remains after the contract and future scaffold gates are applied.
The only remaining route would depend on banned pretrained CV/sign/landmark/model dependencies or unsupported recognition claims.

decision.rationale: The contract is concrete enough to justify a separate no-training scaffold prompt: it names architecture_id and input_contract_id, binds stored and derived tensor axes, forbids early temporal pooling and pretrained/source/tensor/claim changes, defines browser budget and representation diagnostic gates, and keeps fitting/Brev/export/promotion unauthorized. The next useful slice should draft a bounded scaffold prompt, not implement or train in this mission.
